nodes.title: ENTER - Corridor
nodes.text:
You make your way carefully into the dungeon corridor. Damp glistens on the walls, and the air is thick with dust. Feeling your way forward, your eyes slowly begin to adjust to the darkness.

“What have I forgotten to pack?” you ask yourself.

Oh well. Too late now.

You continue for perhaps half a mile without a single junction. The corridor gradually widens, opening into cavernous spaces in places, and you begin to realise that you are slowly but surely descending deeper underground.

You stop to rest.

The darkness around you has become thick and oppressive. You pull out a small flint lantern and strike it. A tiny flame catches on the oil-soaked mantle, casting a weak pool of light around you. You must thank that halfling you met in the Wasted Wizard; if you ever see him again, he parted with this lantern for a hot meal.

It isn’t much, but it is enough to see the tips of your boots and a short distance ahead.

You continue and begin to feel tired; the air is becoming shallow and hard to breath, suddley the corridr open into a junction; some cooler air blows over you like a breath, as though the dungeon itself is breathing! You stop and try not to worry.

As you take you next step you hear a runmble, out of instinct you throw yourself on the ground just in time to feel the ground shake and pieces of rock cover you from behind... 

Lights out!

Turn to 100

nodes.title: Door - Listen first
nodes.text:
You listen at the door and can hear voices behind. Sound like some goblins eating and auduing over their food!

"Give me that bone! you had your share! says one, " get your own you greedy oaf" cries another.

You figure if you let them argue it out maybe the'll be one or two less to gight should you wish to enter.

Do you wait? Go to 25
Or burst in? Go to 374
Or return to the Junction? Go to 100

nodes.title: Stairs
nodes.text: Cold air rises from the darkness below.

nodes.title: Store Room
nodes.text: Only accessible if you have the Iron Key.

nodes.title: Troll Bridge
nodes.text: Before you spans an ancient and very unsafe-looking bridge; you cannot really see what is on the other side, but you think you can see a slight glow, maybe a torch? Halfway across the bridge is a lever.

nodes.title: Troll Den
nodes.text: You peer into the dark cave, which slowley becomes wide and forks off into 2 forections. Bones littler the floors and there is the smell of something boiling down the right tunnel.

nodes.title: Introduction
nodes.text:
The Ghost Bell

Throughout time, or as long as most can remember, the bells of Dragonreach have always been a guiding light to the people of this land, not just to meet on religious days and holidays but also as an early warning of invasion and danger. Some 300 bells are situated in Dragonreach, and the people value them all. A selection of carefully chosen bell wardens would monitor these powerful and ancient bells. Tarak the healer is one of the chosen wardens; he is proud and honoured to be carefully selected.

He would go about his usual duties as a respected healer and spiritual guide to look after not just the people in is ward but in his spare time he would keep and take great care of the bells, restoring, repairing and keeping them oiled and mechanically sound.

One spring morning Tarak is preparing his bags and sachels with herbs and potions to make his visits, he cares a great deal about the local people and they rely on him for health and spiritual guidance. He always takes stock, sometimes very early in the morning, scanning the heavily laden shelves he has built up over the years and is proud of his collection. Some items in Tarak's collection may seem useless to the untrained eye just a lot of powders, liquids and well, letls just say sometimes thing still move in those jars if you look at them long enough! and there's a reson you or I would have no idea what they all do, they are not labbeld, no notes on the contents are written downm inlike those wizards up at the mage towers, they write everyting in a book! proably because they forget after 3 nights on the ale!

A healer would never make up a potion, label it and put it on the shelf for later use. With all the talk and gossip around the Dargonmarch taverns, what if the Shadow Army did invade and they got their hands on his potions? That could be catastrophic. No, an experienced healer would make up the potions as they need them, and his recipes would- well, they would die with him. 

Tarak has, this morning, run out of one vital herb, the herb Travelling Star, a herb needed to cure poison, that and a few other elements, but he needs some and urgently. There is talk of some locals becoming very ill recently due to unsavoury characters poisoning the well. He fears these may be spies for the oncoming attack.

More story to add but basically Tarak goes about his duties relising there is a pioson being dumped intot he rivers by a scout of the shadow army, the he also begins his check of the bell and relaises it has been shatted by a powerful spell and 3 parts of the bell are missing.

He must warn the towns nearby but forst fix the bell!

He makes up a journey potion which he sprinkles around the bell, and breifly it shows up footprints of the intruder, this leads him to a dungeon entrance hidden deep in the nearby hillside.

He enters the tunnels and begins his quest to retrieve the stolen parts of the bell.

This will be a race to find the 3 bell parts and the antidote to the poison before th shadow army attack.

Go to 2

nodes.title: Troll rubbish shoot
nodes.text: You rummage through the piles of stinking bones and discarded previous adventures, only to find a chain mechanism. Will you pull the chain or back away?

nodes.title: Door - Open without listening
nodes.text:
You burst into what looks like a small kitchen or eating area to find 3 large goblins staring back at you.

Roll your dexterity or above to quickly slam the door and block it with a nearby latch. This is a heavy, strong door and as long as you hold that latch down, they won't get out.

If not go to #

If so, you hold the latch down for dear life! And have some time to think! The goblins smash themselves repeatedly at the door (strange because it open inwards) shouting "open this door you little weazel, we'll strip you to the bone and boil you if we  get out!!"

You may...

Smash the door lock shut, bending it with a nearby rock. This will hold until you can escape. Go to 

or prepare yourself and push fast, hopping to knock them back so you can get a drop on them?

nodes.title: Goblin - Kitchen
nodes.text:
Now all the goblins lay slain you look around. This is dirty place that would never get any reviews on Doogle (the wasted wizard notice board). There grease covered burnt pots stacked high, bones and old meat strewn across the floor and the large round table in the middle of the room seems to have a sricky sunstance.

...

nodes.title: Junction
nodes.text:
It's a while before you come round but when you you notice the way back is now blocked by a rock fall. You feel this is now a one way trip and take stock, no harm done as such but you sit for a while and rest. You eventually get to your feet, you take a short drink from you water flask and hope you can find more later and you walk a little futher to a junction.

To the right are some steps, hewn out of the rock, but clearly an ascending route to a higher ledge.

You may...
Listen at the door 13
Open the door, turn to 374
Head up the stairs; turn to 27

nodes.title: Goblin Kitchen - Wait
nodes.text:
You are in no rush; these greedy goblins will be asleep after that meal. You wait and take a little time to meditate a little way back in the darkness, just in case they come out and time some passes.

Finally, you quietly approach the door again, you hear the voices and arguing have died down. You wait a little longer and listen, and you hear snoring.

Slowly open the door, and go in being very careful to not make any sound...

Insdie is a 2 gobins, one asleep on the table and the other laying on a straw bed with an empty bottle of what looks like oil next to him. You draw your dagger and explel the nearest one without a sound. It slumps to the floor and you catch it's fall as black blood runs over you hands.

The other you approch and as you do kick over a can of some kind of slop, roll over your dexterity or more to stop the pot spinning!

if you do you also cut the throat of this vile creature before it can even see you.

If not, it leaps to it's feet and you must fight it.

See combat

nodes.title: Bent Lock - Closes kitchen
nodes.text:
You pick up a nearby heavy rock and smash it over the latch repeatedly, bending it so it could never be opened from the inside. You hear the goblins (now realising) pulling and pushing the door to no avail; these dungeon doors are strongly made, and that's stuck fast.

You won't know how that might of turned out but you feel this could have been a nasty encounter.

You head up the stairs, this being the only way left to go.

Go to 27
